title: enactic/openarm
abstract:
A fully open-source humanoid arm for physical AI research and deployment in contact-rich environments.

# OpenArm **OpenArm** is an open-source 7DOF humanoid arm designed for physical AI research and deployment in contact-rich environments. With high backdrivability and compliance, it is built with safe human-robot interaction in mind while delivering practical payload capabilities for real-world applications. **OpenArm Cell** (on the right) is a standardized environment with unified background, lighting, and camera placement. Research performed using OpenArm can be reproduced around the world in consistent evaluation conditions, facilitating the global discussion on state of the art physical AI research. OpenArm features **human-scale** proportions, safety and compliance, and practical payloads. At $6,500 USD for a complete bimanual system, it provides a flexible platform for teleoperation, imitation learning, simulation, and real-world data collection in contact-rich tasks. *We're in continuous development and actively seeking contributors, research partners, and company collaborators to shape the next generation of practical humanoid systems. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：OpenArm是一个完全开源、高反向驱动性且具备柔顺特性的7自由度人形手臂，并提供标准化的OpenArm Cell环境（统一背景、光照和相机布置），用于遥操作、模仿学习及真实数据采集。


# 一、动机

> 现有物理AI研究在接触丰富环境中缺乏安全、低成本、可复现的开源人形机械臂平台，制约了跨团队对比和数据共享。


# 二、方法

> OpenArm是一个完全开源、高反向驱动性且具备柔顺特性的7自由度人形手臂，并提供标准化的OpenArm Cell环境（统一背景、光照和相机布置），用于遥操作、模仿学习及真实数据采集。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 全套双臂系统成本为6500美元；机械臂具有人类尺度尺寸和实用负载能力，支持接触丰富任务下的安全人机交互与全球统一评估条件复现。


# 四、对我的启发

> 作为持续开发中的开源硬件，其标准化Cell设计有助于提升具身智能研究的可复现性；但尚未给出具体负载/精度实验数据，实际接触任务中的性能有待社区验证。与课题直接相关。
